value.name: asha withholds the pages
value.description: Asha does not take the pages directly, letting them remain between her hand and Daniel's while noting his avoidance of Rosa.
evidence: Asha did not reach for the pages; she let them rest between her hand and his, and noted that he had not looked at Rosa once since the question had been put to her.

value.name: asha reclaims the folded sheet
value.description: Asha pulls the folded sheet back across the desk and places it on her side, asserting control over the document.
evidence: Asha drew the folded sheet back across the desk with two fingers, slow enough that the gesture read less as taking than as ending the question of who held it, and set it on her own side of the wood.

value.name: asha questions rosa about the pages
value.description: Asha asks Rosa when she last saw the pages, pressing her for an explanation.
evidence: Without raising her voice she asked Rosa when she had last seen these.

value.name: rosa calmly deflects with the ink remark
value.description: Rosa answers indirectly by sipping her drink and saying the ink looks fresh, maintaining a composed exterior.
evidence: Rosa lifted the cup she had set down a moment before, took a small sip the way she might have at any other afternoon in this house, and said, almost to the tray, that the ink looked fresh.

value.name: rosa notices daniel's tension
value.description: Rosa briefly looks at Daniel's white-knuckled hand before returning her attention to Asha.
evidence: Her eyes went, only once and only briefly, to Daniel's hand where the knuckles had gone white against the edge of the desk, and then back to Asha.

value.name: daniel falls silent
value.description: Daniel remains silent as his earlier smile fades, leaving the three in a tense new arrangement.
evidence: Daniel did not speak; the smile he had assembled earlier had thinned to something he was no longer maintaining, and the room held the three of them in the new arrangement without anyone moving to soften it.

value.name: asha exposes the signature line
value.description: Asha smooths the crease in the sheet and reveals the lower half of the page, including the paragraph naming the house.
evidence: Asha drew the sheet flat with the heel of her hand, smoothing the long crease open against the desk so the lower half of the page lay exposed between them
the paragraph nearest the signature line, the one that named the house

value.name: rosa silently confirms the incriminating passage
value.description: Rosa studies the paragraph naming the house long enough to answer Asha's question without speaking.
evidence: Rosa did not answer at once; her eyes went to the paragraph nearest the signature line, the one that named the house, and stayed there long enough to be an answer of a kind.

value.name: daniel rises from the desk
value.description: Daniel releases the desk edge and stands up, signaling a shift in the confrontation.
evidence: Daniel let go of the desk edge then, the white pressure leaving his knuckles in stages, and stood
